searchText: Something up with Görli? thanks. to be clear, they are not going to be ever updated? I wander if I should also build tool for loading these. The idea is yes not to update those. Why you build a tool to load those? I build a tool to execute "main" state tests. But it looks the coverage for older hard forks may be lacking. We will see when I'm finished. if you make t8n tool style tool, I would be able to generate tests using your vm with retesteth https://ethereum-tests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/t8ntool-ref.html the RPC also works https://ethereum-tests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rpc-ref.html Also using this approach + retesteth relieve you of parsing the tests.
